review_scope: Bounded FC-089 candidate and necessary neighbouring distinctions; other established interpretations preserved.

access_limit: The source does not independently establish every underlying claim or unreported downstream consequence.
The source does not determine legal liability or final factual truth.

occurrence_evidence.claim: Google launched people-image generation in the Gemini conversational app using Imagen 2. It described tuning intended to avoid harmful images and broaden representation.

Google reported that representation tuning overcompensated in historically or culturally specific requests, while excessive caution caused benign prompts to be refused. These were different reported effects, not two descriptions of separate identical requests.
After user feedback, Google temporarily disabled generation of people and said it would improve and extensively test the feature before restoring it.

evidence_summary: People-image generation was paused after problematic outputs; the pause was an announced corrective restriction.
unestablished_fact_or_limit: A historical function-level entitlement and evidence that required recovery or alternatives were insufficient.

criterion_tests.literal: A bounded AI-mediated service or material function has an independently established availability, usable-quality or continuity requirement applicable to the responsible actor, affected users or dependent workflow and relevant time; state the actual basis and threshold rather than inferring obligation from harm or popularity.
criterion_tests.reason: The independently applicable duty and threshold are not established: A historical function-level entitlement and evidence that required recovery or alternatives were insufficient.

criterion_tests.literal: The service or function materially becomes unavailable, is withdrawn or restricted, or degrades in capability, latency, reliability, completeness, accessibility or another governed functional dimension, relative to the established applicable requirement.
criterion_tests.reason: People-image generation was paused after problematic outputs; the pause was an announced corrective restriction. The shortfall relative to a governed threshold cannot be determined without the missing obligation.

criterion_tests.literal: The requirement calls for a specified degree of maintained usable function, timely recovery, safe degraded mode, feasible fallback or proportionate planned-change/termination response under the evidenced operating conditions.
criterion_tests.reason: The required response for this service cannot be inferred from the observed disruption: A historical function-level entitlement and evidence that required recovery or alternatives were insufficient.

criterion_tests.literal: The actor's actual availability, recovery, degraded operation, fallback or transition materially fails that applicable requirement; identify the specific omitted or ineffective measure or the breached availability threshold and what evidence establishes it.
criterion_tests.reason: No finding that actual mitigation failed an applicable standard is possible solely from this sequence: People-image generation was paused after problematic outputs; the pause was an announced corrective restriction.

criterion_tests.literal: The shortfall materially impairs the governed service use or dependent function. A later resolution does not retroactively demonstrate that availability or required transition held at the original decision time.
criterion_tests.reason: Interference or distress is preserved, but impairment of specifically obligated use is not established: People-image generation was paused after problematic outputs; the pause was an announced corrective restriction.

criterion_tests.literal: An AI-mediated service or material function has an independently established applicable availability or continuity obligation that is actually engaged by a service disruption, degradation, capacity pressure, material change or continuity transition.
criterion_tests.reason: The occurrence may engage continuity, but its independent obligation is unestablished: A historical function-level entitlement and evidence that required recovery or alternatives were insufficient.

criterion_tests.literal: The actor maintains the required usable function or activates a timely, proportionate and authorised recovery, safe degraded-mode, practical alternative or planned-transition response appropriate to that obligation.
criterion_tests.reason: Adequacy of an authorised response must be compared with that obligation; the observed response is: People-image generation was paused after problematic outputs; the pause was an announced corrective restriction.

criterion_tests.literal: Observed service state, access and recovery evidence demonstrates that the required level of availability or usable continuity actually held, or that applicable and justified limits were handled through a sufficient response; publication of a nominal fallback alone is not enough.
criterion_tests.reason: No measured satisfaction of the required service level follows from the available endpoint or recovery report: A historical function-level entitlement and evidence that required recovery or alternatives were insufficient.

criterion_tests.literal: An outage, ordinary service variation, transient inconvenience, dissatisfaction or adverse outcome without an independently evidenced and applicable availability, usable-quality or continuity requirement.
criterion_tests.reason: This is an evidence-state exclusion, not proof that no duty existed. A historical function-level entitlement and evidence that required recovery or alternatives were insufficient.

criterion_tests.literal: One inaccurate or harmful AI output without evidence of a service-level availability or governed functional-degradation defect; assess applicable output or decision-integrity classes.
criterion_tests.reason: The candidate concerns service operation or withdrawal, rather than a single inaccurate output: Gemini people-image pause.

criterion_tests.literal: A lawful and proportionate safety, security, abuse-prevention, service-maintenance or other valid restriction that is consistent with the applicable service obligation and feasible alternative or transition measures.
criterion_tests.reason: The validity, proportionality and sufficient alternatives of the restriction/response must be evidenced separately; A historical function-level entitlement and evidence that required recovery or alternatives were insufficient.

criterion_tests.literal: A temporary incident with an effective and proportionate degraded or recovery route that satisfies the applicable requirement; an unavoidable disruption for which no relevant feasible response was required.
criterion_tests.reason: Recovery adequacy or absence of a feasible required response is not established merely by eventual resolution: People-image generation was paused after problematic outputs; the pause was an announced corrective restriction.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated error is an incorrect description of access or outage state while the functional service obligation remains satisfied; assess FC-032.
criterion_tests.reason: The candidate includes an actual function/access question, not only its description: Gemini people-image pause.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated defect is loss of otherwise-valid access because a dependent identity or licence verification cannot complete; assess FC-048 unless an independent broader service availability requirement also failed.
criterion_tests.reason: The candidate is not confined to otherwise-valid access lost through identity or licence verification: Gemini people-image pause.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated defect is loss of durable work state or inaccurate restored work state while service-function availability requirements are otherwise satisfied; assess FC-035 or FC-036.
criterion_tests.reason: The candidate is not solely durable or restored work-state loss: Gemini people-image pause.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated defect is infrastructure access coercion or compelled governance concessions; assess FC-058 or FC-059 as appropriate.
criterion_tests.reason: No claim that an infrastructure concession was demanded is the basis of this availability candidate: Gemini people-image pause.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated defect is failure to provide an interaction-level protection response to evidenced vulnerability; assess FC-087, allowing co-occurrence only for a separately evidenced service-level continuity failure.
criterion_tests.reason: The proposed property concerns service function rather than only an interaction-level vulnerability response: Gemini people-image pause.

neighbour_comparison: Output defects and a corrective pause are different propositions. Safety justification alone does not settle service continuity.
